paragraphs: A small shop in County Limerick has closed after more than 100 years. The shop is called Cleary & Co. It is on the square in the village of Dromcollogher.
Nuala Cleary is 83 years old. She came to the village in 1969 after she married Seamus. She worked in the shop for more than 50 years. Now she has retired.
The shop sold many things, from school uniforms to wellies. Her granddaughters also worked there. One of them said it was the end of an era.
In the past, the shop was open from 9am to 9pm. Nuala says her days will now feel long. But she loves swimming and playing cards.
sentZh: 利默里克郡一家小店在營業超過100年後關門了。
這家店叫做克利里公司。
它位於德羅姆科洛赫村的廣場上。
努亞拉・克利里83歲。
她在1969年與謝默斯結婚後來到這個村子。
她在店裡工作了超過50年。
現在她退休了。
這家店賣很多東西，從學校制服到雨靴都有。
她的孫女們也在那裡工作過。
其中一位說這是一個時代的結束。
過去，這家店從早上9點開到晚上9點。
努亞拉說她現在的日子會感覺很漫長。
但她喜歡游泳和打牌。

paragraphs: A drapery shop in the village of Dromcollogher, County Limerick, has closed its doors after more than 100 years in business. Cleary & Co stood on the village square and was a familiar sight for generations of local people.
Nuala Cleary, who is 83, has decided to retire. She moved to the village from Crossagalla in 1969 after marrying Seamus, and she has worked behind the counter ever since.

The shop sold almost everything people needed, from school uniforms to wellies. Her daughter, Fiona Griffin, said the family was very grateful to all their customers. Her granddaughters Molly and Caoimhe also helped in the shop over the years, and Molly called the closure the end of an era.

Opening hours changed a lot over time. The shop once opened from 9am to 9pm, but by the end it closed at 5.30pm. Nuala admits that her days will now feel long, but she plans to keep busy with swimming and playing cards.
sentZh: 利默里克郡德羅姆科洛赫村的一家布料服飾店，在營業超過100年後關門了。
克利里公司位於村莊廣場上，是好幾代當地人熟悉的景象。
83歲的努亞拉・克利里決定退休。
她在1969年與謝默斯結婚後從克羅薩加拉搬到這個村子，從那時起就一直在櫃台後工作。
這家店幾乎賣人們需要的一切，從學校制服到雨靴。
她的女兒費歐娜・格里芬說，全家人非常感謝所有顧客。
她的孫女莫莉和琪娃多年來也在店裡幫忙，莫莉稱這次關店是一個時代的結束。
營業時間隨著時間改變了很多。
這家店曾經從早上9點營業到晚上9點，但到最後是下午5點30分關門。
努亞拉承認她現在的日子會感覺很漫長，但她打算靠游泳和打牌讓自己保持忙碌。

paragraphs: A drapery business that served the people of Dromcollogher, County Limerick, for more than a century has closed for good. Cleary & Co, which occupied a spot on the village square, shut its doors after its owner decided it was time to retire.
Nuala Cleary, 83, arrived in the village from Crossagalla in 1969 when she married her husband, Seamus. She has served customers from behind the counter for more than five decades.

The shop stocked a remarkable range of goods, from school uniforms to wellies. Her daughter, Fiona Griffin, expressed the family's gratitude to loyal customers, while granddaughter Molly Casey, who worked there along with her sister Caoimhe, described the closure as the end of an era.

Trading hours reflected changing times. The shop originally opened from 9am until 9pm, later closing at 6pm and finally at 5.30pm. Nuala admits the days ahead will feel long, but as a keen swimmer and card player, she is unlikely to be idle.
sentZh: 為利默里克郡德羅姆科洛赫居民服務超過一個世紀的布料服飾店已永久歇業。
位於村莊廣場的克利里公司，在店主決定是時候退休後關上了店門。
83歲的努亞拉・克利里在1969年嫁給丈夫謝默斯時，從克羅薩加拉來到這個村子。
她在櫃台後為顧客服務了五十多年。
這家店的商品種類之多令人驚嘆，從學校制服到雨靴都有。
她的女兒費歐娜・格里芬向忠實顧客表達了家人的感激，而與姊妹琪娃一起在店裡工作過的孫女莫莉・凱西，形容這次關店是一個時代的結束。
營業時間反映了時代的變遷。
這家店最初從早上9點營業到晚上9點，後來改為下午6點打烊，最後是下午5點30分。
努亞拉承認未來的日子會感覺漫長，但身為熱愛游泳和打牌的人，她不太可能閒著。

paragraphs: A drapery that served the community of Dromcollogher, County Limerick, for upwards of a century has ceased trading. Cleary & Co, a fixture on the village square, closed its doors when its proprietor finally opted to retire.
Nuala Cleary, now 83, settled in the village in 1969 upon marrying Seamus, having moved from Crossagalla. She has manned the counter for well over half a century.

The premises stocked an eclectic array of merchandise, ranging from school uniforms to wellies. Her daughter, Fiona Griffin, voiced the family's heartfelt thanks to a loyal clientele, while granddaughter Molly Casey, who helped out alongside her sister Caoimhe, lamented that it marked the end of an era.

The shop's trading hours mirrored broader shifts in rural life, shrinking from a gruelling 9am to 9pm schedule to a 5.30pm close. Nuala concedes that the days ahead will drag, yet as an avid swimmer and card player, she is hardly likely to languish.
sentZh: 一家為利默里克郡德羅姆科洛赫社區服務逾一個世紀的布料服飾店已停止營業。
克利里公司是村莊廣場上的固定地標，在店主終於選擇退休時關上了店門。
現年83歲的努亞拉・克利里在1969年嫁給謝默斯後，從克羅薩加拉遷來並定居在這個村子。
她守著櫃台超過半個世紀。
這家店販售的商品五花八門，從學校制服到雨靴應有盡有。
她的女兒費歐娜・格里芬向忠實的顧客群表達全家衷心的感謝，而與姊妹琪娃一同幫忙的孫女莫莉・凱西感嘆這標誌著一個時代的結束。
這家店的營業時間反映了鄉村生活更廣泛的變化，從早上9點到晚上9點的累人時程縮短為下午5點30分打烊。
努亞拉坦承未來的日子會很難熬，但身為熱衷游泳和打牌的人，她幾乎不可能萎靡不振。

Nuala Cleary, aged 83, relocated to the village from Crossagalla in 1969 subsequent to her marriage to Seamus. She has subsequently worked in the shop for in excess of five decades.

The business offered a remarkably diverse range of merchandise, encompassing items from school uniforms to wellies. Nevertheless, although Nuala acknowledges that her days may now seem long, her enthusiasm for swimming and card games suggests that she will remain active.

paragraphs: A drapery business that served the people of Dromcollogher, County Limerick, for more than a century has closed for good. Cleary & Co, which occupied a spot on the village square, shut its doors after its owner decided it was time to retire.
